enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping under extra blankets through the cold night
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed on her back. Pulls the extra blanket up to her shoulders. Closes her eyes. Turns onto her right side. Pulls the blanket over her shoulder again. Breathes slowly. Turns onto her left side. Pulls the blanket edge under her chin. Remains still. Adjusts the pillow under her head. Turns onto her back. Extends her right arm out of the blanket. Pulls the arm back under the blanket. Turns onto her right side again. Remains lying still under the blankets until the alarm time.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and dressing in warm layers for the chilly morning
enriched_activities.desc: Opens her eyes. Pushes the extra blanket down to her waist. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Puts both feet on the floor. Stands up. Walks to the light switch and presses it on. Walks to the wardrobe and opens the door. Takes out a long-sleeved shirt. Takes out a wool sweater. Takes out a pair of trousers. Lays the clothes on the bed. Takes off the nightclothes. Pulls on the long-sleeved shirt. Pulls the sweater over her head. Pulls on the trousers. Puts on socks. Puts on slippers. Closes the wardrobe door.

enriched_activities.activity: Having a hot breakfast together with Member 2 (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from Bedroom 3 to the Kitchen. Presses the Kitchen light switch on. Walks to the counter. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water from the tap. Puts the kettle on its base and presses the switch. Opens the cabinet door. Takes out two bowls. Takes out two cups. Closes the cabinet door. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the eggs in a pot and turns on the InductionCooker. Puts bread in the Toaster and presses the lever down. Says to Member 2: 'Breakfast is ready.' Pours hot water into the two cups. Puts the tea bags in the cups. Carries the bowls and cups to the table. Sits down at the table with Member 2. Picks up the spoon and eats. Drinks the tea. Stands up and carries the empty bowls to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face and finishing getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to the Bathroom. Presses the Bathroom light switch on. Turns the tap handle. Puts both hands under the running water. Rubs soap on her hands. Washes her face with both hands. Turns the tap handle off. Picks up the towel from the hook. Wipes her face with the towel. Hangs the towel back on the hook. Picks up the comb. Combs her hair. Puts the comb down on the shelf. Opens the cabinet door. Takes out a hand cream tube. Squeezes cream onto her palm. Rubs the cream into both hands. Closes the cabinet door. Presses the Bathroom light switch off. Walks out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing the breakfast dishes, wiping down counters and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Turns the tap handle on. Picks up the sponge. Squeezes dish soap onto the sponge. Picks up a bowl. Wipes the inside of the bowl with the sponge. Rinses the bowl under the running water. Places the bowl in the drying rack. Picks up the second bowl and repeats the wash and rinse. Picks up the two cups. Wipes the inside of each cup. Rinses the cups. Places the cups in the drying rack. Picks up the plates and the spoons and washes them. Rinses them and places them in the drying rack. Turns the tap handle off. Picks up the dish towel. Wipes the countertop from left to right. Wipes the stovetop around the InductionCooker. Wipes the table surface. Hangs the dish towel on the hook. Opens the lower cabinet and puts the pots away. Closes the cabinet door.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting and running a load of laundry, then drying the clothes in the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to the Bathroom. Carries the laundry basket. Sets the basket on the floor. Opens the WashingMachine lid. Picks up the white clothes and drops them into the drum. Picks up the colored clothes and drops them into the drum. Picks up the towels and drops them into the drum. Picks up the laundry detergent bottle. Unscrews the cap. Pours detergent into the cap. Pours the detergent into the drum. Screws the cap back on the bottle. Puts the bottle back on the shelf. Closes the WashingMachine lid. Presses the power button. Presses the program button until the wash cycle is selected. Presses the start button. Stands and waits. When the cycle ends, opens the lid. Pulls the wet clothes out one item at a time. Puts the wet clothes into the ClothesDryer. Closes the ClothesDryer door. Presses the power button on the ClothesDryer. Presses the start button. Waits until the drying cycle ends. Opens the ClothesDryer door. Takes the dried clothes out. Folds the clothes and stacks them in the basket. Carries the basket out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and sitting down for a short morning break
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Carries the basket of folded clothes and sets it on the counter. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water at the tap. Puts the kettle back on its base and presses the switch. Opens the cabinet door. Takes out a cup. Closes the cabinet door. Opens the drawer. Takes out a tea bag. Closes the drawer. Drops the tea bag into the cup. Presses the kettle switch off when the water boils. Pours the hot water into the cup. Picks up the cup and carries it to the table. Pulls the chair back. Sits down on the chair. Picks up the cup and drinks the tea in sips. Sets the cup down on the table. Picks up the Phone from her pocket and looks at the screen. Presses the screen and scrolls. Puts the Phone down on the table. Picks up the cup and finishes the tea. Stands up. Carries the cup to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting in her room with the desk lamp on, checking her phone and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to Bedroom 3. Presses the Bedroom 3 light switch on. Walks to the desk. Presses the DeskLamp switch on. Pulls the chair out. Sits down on the chair at the desk. Picks up the Phone. Presses the power button. Swipes the screen. Scrolls through the message list. Taps a message and reads it. Taps the reply box. Types a reply with both thumbs. Presses send. Puts the Phone down on the desk. Opens the desk drawer. Takes out a book. Closes the drawer. Opens the book to the bookmark page. Reads with the book held in both hands. Turns a page. Turns another page. Closes the book. Puts the book back in the drawer. Closes the drawer. Picks up the Phone again. Presses the screen and reads. Puts the Phone down. Presses the DeskLamp switch off. Stands up. Pushes the chair back under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple hot lunch on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from Bedroom 3 to the Kitchen. Presses the Kitchen light switch on. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out vegetables and tofu. Closes the refrigerator door. Walks to the sink. Turns the tap on. Rinses the vegetables under the water. Turns the tap off. Places the vegetables on the cutting board. Picks up the knife. Cuts the vegetables into pieces. Picks up the tofu and cuts it into cubes. Places the cut pieces in a bowl. Presses the InductionCooker power button on. Presses the heat setting button. Pours oil into the pan. Waits for the pan to heat. Pours the vegetables into the pan. Picks up the spatula and stirs. Pours the tofu into the pan. Stirs again. Picks up the salt container and shakes salt into the pan. Presses the InductionCooker power button off. Picks up the plate and slides the food onto it. Carries the plate to the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and cleaning the dishes afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Pulls the chair back. Sits down at the table. Picks up the chopsticks. Picks up a piece of vegetable and eats it. Picks up a piece of tofu and eats it. Picks up the bowl and drinks the soup. Sets the bowl down. Takes another bite with the chopsticks. Finishes the food on the plate. Stands up. Carries the plate, bowl and chopsticks to the sink. Turns the tap on. Picks up the sponge. Squeezes dish soap onto the sponge. Wipes the plate with the sponge. Rinses the plate under the running water. Places the plate in the drying rack. Washes the bowl and the chopsticks in the same way. Rinses them and places them in the drying rack. Turns the tap off. Picks up the dish towel. Wipes the table surface. Wipes the countertop. Hangs the dish towel on the hook. Washes her hands. Dries her hands on the towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an afternoon nap
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to Bedroom 3. Presses the Bedroom 3 light switch off. Walks to the bed. Pulls the blanket down. Sits on the edge of the bed. Swings both legs onto the bed. Lies down on her back. Pulls the blanket up to her chest. Turns onto her right side. Closes her eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns onto her left side. Pulls the blanket up to her shoulder. Remains lying still. Turns onto her back. Extends her right arm out of the blanket. Pulls the arm back under. Lies still on the bed until the nap ends. Opens her eyes. Pushes the blanket back. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local shops in warm clothing to buy groceries and fresh food for the household
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from Bedroom 3 to the entryway. Opens the closet door. Takes out the coat. Puts both arms into the coat sleeves. Buttons the coat. Takes the scarf from the hook and wraps it around her neck. Puts the hat on her head. Picks up the shopping bag from the hook. Opens the front door. Steps outside. Closes the front door. Walks along the pavement toward the shops. Walks past the crossing. Reaches the shop entrance. Pushes the shop door open. Walks in. Picks up a shopping basket with her right hand. Walks to the vegetable shelf. Picks up a bag of greens and puts it in the basket. Picks up tomatoes and puts them in the basket. Walks to the refrigerator shelf. Opens the door. Takes out a carton of milk. Takes out a pack of eggs. Closes the door. Places the milk and eggs in the basket. Walks to the counter. Sets the basket on the counter. Says to the shop staff: 'That's all, thank you.' Picks up the items and puts them in her shopping bag. Pays with the Phone. Picks up the shopping bag. Walks out of the shop. Walks back along the pavement to the house. Opens the front door and steps inside. Closes the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and storing items in the refrigerator, freezer and pantry
enriched_activities.desc: Takes off the hat and scarf and hangs them on the hook. Takes off the coat and hangs it in the closet. Carries the shopping bag to the Kitchen. Sets the bag on the counter. Takes the milk carton out of the bag. Opens the refrigerator door. Places the milk on the shelf. Closes the refrigerator door. Takes the eggs out of the bag. Places the egg carton in the refrigerator door shelf. Closes the refrigerator door. Takes the greens out of the bag and places them in the vegetable drawer. Closes the refrigerator door. Takes the frozen food package out of the bag. Opens the Freezer door. Places the package inside. Closes the Freezer door. Takes the dry goods out of the bag. Opens the pantry door. Places the items on the shelf. Closes the pantry door. Folds the empty shopping bag. Puts the bag in the drawer. Closes the drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet rest in her room with the desk lamp on, reading and warming up
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to Bedroom 3. Presses the Bedroom 3 light switch on. Walks to the desk. Presses the DeskLamp switch on. Pulls the chair out. Sits down on the chair. Opens the desk drawer. Takes out the book. Closes the drawer. Opens the book at the bookmark and reads. Turns a page. Turns another page. Picks up the Phone from the desk. Presses the screen and looks at it. Puts the Phone down. Continues reading. Turns another page. Closes the book. Puts the book back in the drawer. Closes the drawer. Stands up. Pushes the chair in. Presses the DeskLamp switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing ingredients and side dishes for the household dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from Bedroom 3 to the Kitchen. Presses the Kitchen light switch on. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes the refrigerator door. Carries the items to the sink. Turns the tap on. Rinses the vegetables under the water. Turns the tap off. Places the vegetables on the cutting board. Picks up the knife. Cuts the vegetables into slices. Cuts the meat into pieces. Places the cut vegetables in a bowl. Places the meat in another bowl. Opens the cabinet door. Takes out the spices. Closes the cabinet door. Picks up the soy sauce bottle. Pours soy sauce over the meat. Puts the bottle down. Picks up the spice jar and sprinkles spice over the meat. Picks up the chopsticks and mixes the meat in the bowl. Opens the RiceCooker lid. Pours rice into the inner pot. Turns the tap on and rinses the rice. Pours the rinse water out. Adds water to the pot. Closes the lid. Presses the RiceCooker switch down.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a warm dinner together with Member 2 (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Presses the InductionCooker power button on. Pours oil into the pan. Pours the meat into the pan. Picks up the spatula and stirs the meat. Pours the vegetables into the pan. Stirs with the spatula. Picks up the salt container and shakes salt into the pan. Presses the InductionCooker power button off. Picks up the plates and slides the food onto them. Says to Member 2: 'Dinner is ready, come and eat.' Carries the plates to the table. Opens the RiceCooker lid. Picks up the rice paddle. Scoops rice into two bowls. Closes the RiceCooker lid. Carries the bowls to the table. Pulls the chair back. Sits down at the table with Member 2. Picks up the chopsticks. Picks up food and eats. Picks up the bowl and drinks the soup. Talks with Member 2 about the groceries bought today. Finishes the rice in the bowl. Sets the chopsticks down on the plate. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing the dishes and wiping down the kitchen surfaces together with Member 2 (joint activity)
enriched_activities.desc: Carries the plates and bowls from the table to the sink. Turns the tap on. Picks up the sponge. Squeezes dish soap onto the sponge. Hands the second sponge to Member 2. Wipes a plate with the sponge. Rinses the plate under the running water. Hands the plate to Member 2, who dries it. Washes the bowls in the same way. Washes the chopsticks. Rinses the pans and places them in the drying rack. Turns the tap off. Picks up the dish towel. Wipes the countertop. Wipes the stovetop around the InductionCooker. Wipes the table surface. Hangs the dish towel on the hook. Pushes the chairs back under the table. Presses the Kitchen light switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching television and relaxing on the sofa with Member 2 until 20:30, then relaxing in the warm living room (joint activity 19:30-20:30)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Presses the Living Room light switch on. Picks up the remote control from the table. Presses the power button to turn on the TV. Sits down on the sofa next to Member 2. Presses the channel button. Sets the remote down on the sofa arm. Watches the TV screen. Leans back against the sofa cushion. Picks up the remote and presses the volume button. Sets the remote down. Points at the screen and says to Member 2: 'This program again.' Watches the screen. Adjusts her sitting position. Picks up the cup of water from the table and drinks. Sets the cup down. Watches the screen. Presses the power button to turn the TV off at 20:30. Stands up. Walks to the window and pulls the curtain closed. Walks back and sits on the sofa. Picks up the Phone and presses the screen. Reads the screen. Puts the Phone down on the table. Leans back on the sofa. Stands up at 21:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Living Room to the Bathroom. Presses the Bathroom light switch on. Presses the WaterHeater switch on. Opens the shower curtain. Turns the shower tap handle. Puts her hand under the water to test it. Steps into the shower. Washes her body with soap. Rinses the soap off. Washes her hair with shampoo. Rinses the hair. Turns the shower tap handle off. Steps out of the shower. Picks up the towel from the hook. Dries her body with the towel. Dries her hair with the towel. Hangs the towel on the hook. Pulls on the nightclothes. Presses the WaterHeater switch off. Presses the Bathroom light switch off. Walks out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, checking her phone and noting things to be grateful for
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Bathroom to Bedroom 3. Presses the Bedroom 3 light switch on. Pulls the blanket down. Sits on the edge of the bed. Swings both legs onto the bed. Lies down. Pulls the blanket up to her chest. Picks up the Phone from the bedside table. Presses the power button. Swipes the screen. Scrolls through the message list. Presses the screen to open a note app. Types a line of text with both thumbs. Types another line. Presses save. Puts the Phone down on the bedside table. Presses the Bedroom 3 light switch off. Pulls the extra blanket up over the first blanket. Closes her eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, keeping extra blankets on against the overnight cold
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed with her eyes closed. Pulls the extra blanket up to her shoulders. Turns onto her right side. Pulls the blanket over her shoulder. Breathes slowly. Turns onto her left side. Adjusts the pillow under her head. Turns onto her back. Extends her right arm out of the blanket. Pulls the arm back under the blanket. Turns onto her right side again. Remains lying still under the two blankets. Does not get up. Remains in bed until the end of the night.
